title: TEXAS ROADHOUSE!
description: ok more like the whitetrash roadhouse... and u kno im not that big of a food snob... but come on! this place is GARBAGE! what is its appeal.... what you are looking at is some green beans in a little cup... some salmon entree.... the Outback Steakhouse knock-off "bloomin onion" or whatever they call it there... and whatever the hell my mom had! AND ON TOP OF IT! it costs like $76 before tip for the food u see here!
